title: Toppen app💗
body: Jag tycker det är en super bra app, ger mig verkligen motivationen jag behöver och det blir enklare för mig att både göra och följa rutiner. Appen får 4/5 stjärnor av mig eftersom det kanske är lite synd att man behöver köpa premium versionen för fler trädgårdar. Tycker att 55kr/ månaden är ganska mycket, det hade varit bra om man kunde testa en månad eller typ två veckor för lite billigare peng så man kan känna in appen lite mer och tänka över vad man tycker om premium versionen. Men allmänt är det en super bra app för dig som vill ha rutiner, vanor eller liknande. Super bra app, ladda ner och ge den ett försök💓

title: Beautiful!
body:
Absolutely love it! 

One little wish from my end, and something I believe many users would want. It would be amazing to be able to add habits that are not daily. 

For example working out, maybe I have that 3 days a week, so I would wish to be able to create this habit in the app, by adding a certain goal, to reoccurring specific days of the week.
author: NyGc

title: Beautiful app and very motivational
body:
This app is beautifully designed along with offering an incentive to care for something by completing daily tasks. I find myself caring more when I have something to care for that can wilt if I choose not to or don’t feel like living up to my responsibilities. I like that you can’t pause it and the consequences of not doing what you’ve set yourself out to do are visual and a bit painful. Either you do the things you’ve set yourself out to do or you do not. It doesn’t care for excuses. Much like caring for a real plant demands real nurture, not excuses as to why it wasn’t nurtured. Works wonders for me. 

I’d love if there was a widget where you could simple see your plant without any quotes or checklists. Also if your plant swayed and move a bit so it communicated “life”, if that makes sense. Perhaps, it could also be synced and reflect the weather at your location.

Solid product as it is though.
